CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authoritative_role()
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.authoritative_role(auth.uid())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authoritative_role(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH caller AS (
    SELECT
      auth.uid() AS uid,
      COALESCE(auth.role(), '') AS jwt_role
  )
  SELECT target.role
  FROM public.profiles AS target
  CROSS JOIN caller
  WHERE target.user_id = _user_id
    AND (
      _user_id = caller.uid
      OR caller.jwt_role = 'service_role'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles AS admin_profile
        WHERE admin_profile.user_id = caller.uid
          AND admin_profile.role = 'admin'::public.user_role
      )
    )
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_open_house_pof_reviews(p_listing_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, requester_id uuid, proof_of_funds_url text, proof_amount numeric, pof_verified_status text, pof_rejection_reason text, created_at timestamp with time zone, listing_id uuid, rejection_reason text, status oh_registration_status, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(private.has_platform_admin(auth.uid()),false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_admin_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT r.id,r.requester_id,r.proof_of_funds_url,r.proof_amount,r.pof_verified_status,r.pof_rejection_reason,r.created_at,r.listing_id,r.rejection_reason,r.status,r.updated_at FROM public.open_house_registrations r
  WHERE r.proof_of_funds_url IS NOT NULL AND (p_listing_id IS NULL OR r.listing_id=p_listing_id)
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 100;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_open_house_listing_context(p_listing_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, owner_id uuid, title text, city text, address text, cover_image_url text, open_house_date timestamp with time zone, price numeric, open_house_transaction_type text, open_house_settings jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_listing_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_listing_ids)>100 OR array_position(p_listing_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_open_house_listing_ids' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT l.id,l.owner_id,l.title,l.city,l.address,l.cover_image_url,l.open_house_date,l.price,l.open_house_transaction_type,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',s.id,'listing_id',s.listing_id,'timeslots',s.timeslots,'max_visitors_per_slot',s.max_visitors_per_slot,
      'max_total_visitors',s.max_total_visitors,'broker_required',s.broker_required,
      'require_proof_of_funds',s.require_proof_of_funds,'min_proof_amount',s.min_proof_amount,
      'require_investor_declaration',s.require_investor_declaration,'offer_deadline',s.offer_deadline,
      'allow_sealed_bids',s.allow_sealed_bids,'created_at',s.created_at,'updated_at',s.updated_at))
      FROM public.open_house_settings s WHERE s.listing_id=l.id AND private.can_read_open_house_settings(l.id)), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.listings l WHERE l.id=ANY(p_listing_ids)
    AND (l.listing_type='open_house' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.open_house_settings s WHERE s.listing_id=l.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.open_house_registrations r WHERE r.listing_id=l.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.open_house_offers o WHERE o.listing_id=l.id))
    AND (l.owner_id=auth.uid() OR (l.status='active' AND l.is_off_market=false AND (
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.open_house_registrations r WHERE r.listing_id=l.id AND r.requester_id=auth.uid())
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.open_house_offers o WHERE o.listing_id=l.id AND o.bidder_id=auth.uid()))));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_platform_admin(_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.authoritative_role(_user_id) = 'admin'::public.user_role
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.authoritative_role()
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select private.authoritative_role((select auth.uid()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.authoritative_role(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select role
  from public.profiles
  where user_id = _user_id
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_read_open_house_settings(p_listing_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.listings l WHERE l.id=p_listing_id
    AND ((l.status='active' AND l.listing_type='open_house' AND l.is_off_market=false)
      OR l.owner_id=(SELECT auth.uid())))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_select_open_house_document(p_requester_id text, p_listing_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.open_house_registrations AS registration
    JOIN public.listings AS listing
      ON listing.id = registration.listing_id
    WHERE registration.requester_id::TEXT = p_requester_id
      AND registration.listing_id::TEXT = p_listing_id
      AND listing.owner_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_user_owns_listing(p_listing_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.listings AS l
      WHERE l.id = p_listing_id
        AND l.owner_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
    ),
    false
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_platform_admin(_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select private.authoritative_role(_user_id) = 'admin'::public.user_role
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notify_open_house_pof_status_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor UUID := COALESCE(NEW.approved_by, (SELECT auth.uid()));
  v_listing_title TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.pof_verified_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.pof_verified_status THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.pof_verified_status IS NULL OR NEW.pof_verified_status NOT IN ('verified', 'rejected') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT title INTO v_listing_title
  FROM public.listings
  WHERE id = NEW.listing_id
  LIMIT 1;

  PERFORM private.insert_interaction_notification(
    NEW.requester_id,
    v_actor,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.pof_verified_status = 'verified' THEN 'Proof of funds verified'
      ELSE 'Proof of funds rejected'
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.pof_verified_status = 'verified'
        THEN concat_ws(' ', 'Your proof of funds for', COALESCE(NULLIF(v_listing_title, ''), 'an open house'), 'was verified.')
      ELSE concat_ws(' ', 'Your proof of funds for', COALESCE(NULLIF(v_listing_title, ''), 'an open house'), 'was rejected.', NULLIF(NEW.pof_rejection_reason, ''))
    END,
    'pof_review',
    '/dashboard?tab=open-houses'
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_open_house_offer(p_listing_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_currency text DEFAULT 'EUR'::text)
 RETURNS open_house_offers
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_offer public.open_house_offers%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.open_house_offers (
    listing_id,
    bidder_id,
    amount,
    currency,
    message,
    status,
    submitted_at
  )
  VALUES (
    p_listing_id,
    v_actor,
    p_amount,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p_currency, ''), 'EUR'),
    NULLIF(p_message, ''),
    'submitted',
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (listing_id, bidder_id) DO UPDATE
  SET
    amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
    currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
    message = EXCLUDED.message,
    status = 'submitted',
    submitted_at = now(),
    revealed_at = NULL,
    decided_by = NULL,
    decided_at = NULL
  WHERE public.open_house_offers.status = 'submitted'
  RETURNING * INTO v_offer;

  IF v_offer.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'offer_no_longer_editable';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_offer;
END;
$function$
